definitions.explanation: Something that breaks easily, such as glass, china or pottery, especially when it is being packed, shipped or handled. {割|わ}れ{物|もの}{注意|ちゅうい} is the "Fragile" label on a parcel.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}れ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割|わ}れ{物|もの}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The contents are fragile, so please carry it carefully.

notes:
From ⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ (to break, to crack) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧. Also written われ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割|わ}れ{物|もの}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: Fragile (label)
- {割|わ}れ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send fragile goods
- {割|わ}れ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as if handling something fragile (treating someone very delicately)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {壊|こわ}れ{物|もの}: also "fragile item"; {割|わ}れ{物|もの} is the usual word for glass and china, {壊|こわ}れ{物|もの} covers anything easily damaged
